innovation.summary: The project demonstrates significant innovation through the development of advanced semiconductor technologies, including a new generation IGBT platform and deep submicron BCD technology. The organization has applied for numerous patents, indicating a strong commitment to intellectual property and technological advancement.
key_points: The organization has applied for over 80 domestic patents and one US patent.
The new generation IGBT technology platform operates at 900-6500 volts and is in the research and development stage.
The IGBT technology platform features industry-leading levels in saturation voltage drop, temperature coefficient, parameter consistency, and short-circuit current capability.
The deep submicron BCD technology platform operates at 5-60 volts and is being developed in collaboration with a well-known international 12-inch wafer factory.
The company's MOSFET platform combines the latest wafer technology with process technology and device structure design.
The SJ MOSFET process features a special device cell and terminal structure design for cost-effectiveness and high robustness.
